channel.title: Boulder City Review - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from Boulder City Review (bouldercityreview.com)

item.title: Lady Eagles to host playoff game
item.description: Finishing the regular season on a high note, Boulder City High School girls basketball won their last two regular-season games, earning the right to host a home playoff game.

item.title: Dynamic duo lead Eagles basketball into playoffs
item.description: Ending the regular season on a high note with a 17-10 record, Boulder City High School boys basketball won their final two regular-season games.

item.title: Damboree water zone may dry up
item.description: The July 4 Damboree is not only one of the most popular parades in the state, it is a big part of Boulder City’s history.

item.title: Former Milo’s to reopen later this year
item.description: Bought by owners of Nora’s Italian Cuisine

item.title: Cox awards $250K for railroad trail
item.description: It’s one of the most popular trails within the Lake Mead National Recreation Area, and thanks to a generous grant, will soon be receiving a makeover.

item.title: Protecting student programs at King
item.description: Editor’s Note: After the printing of this edition, Martha P. King Elementary received word from the school district that it won its budget appeal and that both the PE and music positions will not have to go part-time this fall.

item.title: Just play by the rules during the parade
item.description: If you’re reading this and have not yet read the page 1 article about the concerns of the Damboree committee and the popular water zone, I will stop typing until you do.

item.title: No deal: Colorado River states wave white flag ahead of Trump admin deadline
item.description: The seven states that share the Colorado River will miss another deadline from the Trump administration to cut a 20-year deal assigning shortages among them. It’s unclear what happens next.

item.title: Lady Eagles advance to state tourney
item.description: Boulder City High School girls basketball will be making their first 3A state tournament appearance since 2019.

item.title: Ruth, Burrows make state podium
item.description: Competing at the 3A state meet, Boulder City High School wrestlers Otis Ruth and Coen Burrows made their way onto the podium at the Winnemucca Events Center on Feb. 14.
